answer: Because the garden stake is held until the karst settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the whisper audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 46% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A farm running 153 keys thus burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
